thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGING: p99 tail spike observed on streaming generation for hosted-int8-variants across us-east-1 and eu-west-1. p95 ~ 300ms, p99 ~ 2.1s (normal p99 ~ 450ms). Calibration profile 'int8-v3' rolled out 09:12 UTC and coincides with spike. Investigating.

mike_oncall: acked. i'm paged, joining. any evidence of customer error or config? :pager:

anya_sre: seeing a pattern — streaming stalls (clients hang waiting for tokens) and then bursts where responses come in chunks. metrics show KV cache misses skyrocketing and CPU on some inference nodes pegged.

sofia_ml: confirming: int8-v3 introduced a tighter quantization schedule + aggressive KV packing. suspect degenerate dequant path for long-context streaming causing stalls at tail. may be regressions in calibration tables.

shane_runtime: logs from a few hosts show repeated 'kv-fetch-timeout' and 'dequant-retry' errors. stack traces point to the dequant kernel fallback slow path. putting a quick grep here:
```
[2026-03-15T09:18:03Z] ERROR dequant_kv.cpp:487 kv-fetch-timeout model=int8-v3 req=stream-12345
[2026-03-15T09:18:03Z] WARN runtime_fallback.cpp:233 falling back to fp16 dequant path (slow)
```

mike_oncall: ok actionable checklist: 1) mitigate customer impact now 2) triage root cause 3) hotpatch/rollback. who can flip routing or revert profile quickly?

evan_support: CS already received two high-priority tickets (CS-7891, CS-7892) — customers report streaming stalls up to 10s then partial payloads. flagged for SLA risk.

ops_pat: pinged affected customers, told them we're investigating and may reroute traffic. asking for ETA.

shane_runtime: we can force a routing bypass for int8-v3 to go to fp16-compat or previous int8-v2 profile per-host. command:
```
# quick rollback command (internal)
redwoodctl routing update --model-profile int8-v3 --route-fallback int8-v2 --region us-east-1,eu-west-1
```
This will send new requests to int8-v2 but existing connections may still hit old nodes.

sofia_ml: alternative: disable the new calibration tables globally (fast) — flips quant path to runtime fallback earlier and avoids dequant slowpath. risk: small perf regression but stable.

mike_oncall: prioritize customer stability. recommend global disable of calibration tables + start rollback to int8-v2. shane, can you run both? i'll coordinate with infra.

shane_runtime: initiating global calibration disable now. will post status. :hammer_and_wrench:

deploy-bot: deploy started: calibrations:disable @service=runtime-inference scope=global user=shane_runtime id=depl-3821

shane_runtime: calibrations:disable completed on us-east-1 (10/12 hosts) in ~45s, starting eu-west-1. seeing immediate drop in 'dequant-retry' logs.

infra-bot: autoscaler note — CPU dropped ~30% on impacted pools after disable. no autoscaler bounce.

anya_sre: monitoring p99 — preliminary: us-east-1 p99 trending down from 2.1s -> 680ms within 2 minutes of disable. still above SLO.

sofia_ml: kicking rollback to int8-v2 for new requests now. issuing staged rollout: 20%->50%->100% over 10m windows.

shane_runtime: applied routing update to 20% for us-east-1. will watch error budget and stalls.

mike_oncall: good. set an alert for any rise in 'streaming stall' logs. keep CS updated.

evan_support: CS updated customers: told them we're rolling back the new quantization profile and expect restoration within 15-25m. one customer asked for dedicated routing — is that possible?

shane_runtime: dedicated routing is possible but requires provisioning and may take longer. for immediate relief, we can pin the customer's traffic to int8-v2 via per-tenant route override. could do that in 5m if needed.

ops_pat: customer A requested pinning. sending tenant id. please pin and confirm once done.

shane_runtime: pinned customer A to int8-v2 in us-east-1. confirm?

ops_pat: confirmed via customer. they reported tail reduced to ~500ms for streaming. :thumbsup:

anya_sre: at 20% canary we still see tail outliers in older hosts (likely sticky sessions). suggest force-drain of nodes still running int8-v3 and prevent new sessions on them.

shane_runtime: initiating drain on nodes with int8-v3. command:
```
redwoodctl host drain --tag profile=int8-v3 --region us-east-1
```
This takes ~2-5m per host to finish.

deploy-bot: rollback staged: int8-v2 -> 50% at 09:34 UTC (id=depl-3822)

sofia_ml: telemetry note — calibration tables for int8-v3 had an edge case on long ctx lengths (>2048) that caused an index misalign in dequant map. reproducing locally. looks like calibration fallout not accounted for rare token patterns.

anya_sre: capturing logs and sample traces for postmortem. saving a set of traces where stall > 1s and ctx > 2048.

mike_oncall: oncall handoff — i need to drop in 20m. anyone can take lead after 09:50 UTC?

anya_sre: i can take lead. will coordinate final rollback to 100% and start postmortem.

shane_runtime: rolling out to 100% now in both regions.

deploy-bot: rollback completed to int8-v2 @09:42 UTC across regions (id=depl-3822)

infra-bot: all nodes report calibration=disabled or profile=int8-v2. CPU and latency normalized. p99 now ~420ms, p95 ~280ms.

anya_sre: marking incident as mitigated for customer-facing impact. still collecting artifacts for RCA. creating postmortem ticket PM-1134.

evan_support: documenting CS notes and mapping affected tenants. will follow up with tailored mitigation for each.

ops_pat: closing the immediate paging. customers notified. keep me in the loop for RCA and any follow-ups.

mike_oncall: thanks team. handoff to @anya_sre for RCA. i'll be reachable if needed. :raised_hands:

sofia_ml: initial RCA hypothesis: int8-v3 calibration table generation had an off-by-one in the index for long-context buckets leading to invalid dequant map lookups, which triggered fallback slow-paths and KV fetch timeouts causing prolonged stalls. fix will include: fix calibration generator, add unit tests for ctx>2048, add a canary that runs long-context synthetic workload before wide rollout.

anya_sre: next steps (short): 1) postmortem PM-1134 2) patch calibration generator + tests 3) add pre-rollout synthetic long-ctx canary 4) update rollout playbook to include quick disable path and tenant pin recipe.

evan_support: ETA for patch?

sofia_ml: aiming for hotfix + test + deploy early tomorrow (UTC), will try to fast-track if customers need earlier rollback.

mike_oncall: nice work. incident closed -> mitigated. :white_check_mark:

ops_pat: logging ticket closure in CS and follow-ups.

anya_sre: assigning postmortem ownership to sofia_ml and shane_runtime. will share draft PM in eng-postmortems.

incident-bot: Incident 2026-03-15T09:12Z: mitigated -> status: postmortem_required (PM-1134). Pager cleared.
